The '''ruins''' in level 21 [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon|Wilderness]] are all that remain of the [[Zarosian]] fortress and village once known as [[Dareeyak]]. The ruins are located west of the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]] and south of the [[Forgotten Cemetery]].
==Transportation==
* {{Plink|Dareeyak Teleport}} — ruins centre. Requires completion of [[Desert Treasure I]].
* {{Plink|Burning amulet}} — [[Bandit Camp]], south-east of the ruins
* {{Plink|Wilderness Obelisk|txt=Obelisk|pic=Obelisk (Construction) icon}} — level 27 Wilderness, north-east of the ruins.
* {{Plink|Cemetery Teleport}} — [[The Forgotten Cemetery]], shortly north of the ruins.
* {{Plink|Ghommal's hilt 1}} or above — God Wars Dungeon entrance. Run south-east, climb the [[Rocks (Wilderness, Trollheim)|rocks]], run east again, and climb the rocks into the Wilderness. 
* {{Plink|Ring of dueling}} — [[Ferox Enclave]], a long run east of the ruins.

== Features ==
There are no standing buildings remaining in the area. A lone, functional [[anvil]] can be found in the south-east corner of the ruins, but due to its danger and distance from a bank, it is rarely used to train [[Smithing]].

The main feature of the ruins is the [[crazy archaeologist]], a lower-difficulty boss who can be found roaming the northern part of the ruins. Passing players should be careful, as he is [[aggressive]] and will attack players on sight. It is advised that low-level players who wish to explore this area for reasons other than [[clue scroll]]s or bossing should use [[free-to-play]] worlds, as he is only present in [[members]].
